statement: For every prime p >= 37 with p congruent to 1 modulo 12, the parameter count N_p defined in problem.md is positive; equivalently, some Alexander quandle Alex(F_p,f_a) in the frozen scope has a nontrivial idempotent in its integral quandle ring. Moreover N_13 = 0, so 13 is the unique prime congruent to 1 modulo 12 without such a parameter.
contribution: A complete proof of the frozen claim: for the canonical sextic character, S_p = (1,5)_6 + (5,1)_6 satisfies S_p >= (p + 1 - 14 sqrt(p))/18, which is positive for p >= 194; an exact exhaustive discrete-log computation supplies witnesses for every eligible prime 37 <= p < 194 and a complete certificate that N_13 = 0. No novelty or priority claim is made.
